sourceLocalClaims: Existing monthly kernel control flow retains the specialty gate, thirty ordered facility observations, corresponding-completed helper captures and governor politics capture.
Each called item retains full input, full result.observations, every captured return, arithmetic, quantity request and all twenty-two evidence fields.

Count one uses binary32 factor 1 / bits1065353216; count two uses 1.5 / bits1069547520. For selected governor politics p=0..100, term=floor(p/2)+60 and scaled=term*factor*3; truncation gives requested quantity 180..495. The full source kernel still performs its original arithmetic.
The memory constants and converter remain documented replaceable assumptions; the external listing does not certify exact PC-PK1.1 source version, native helper bodies or complete monthly caller.

Shared construction rate and ordinary production preserve complete prior audits and source uncertainty, including construction work versus HP and the unresolved original ordinary quantity reward-attribute conflict.
suppliedFacts: Fixed city, force, corps, positions, ownership, initial ledger, four equipment inventory quantities and capacities, complete production prices and construction catalog
One to eight officers with stable U8 abilities and supplied initial progress; only the selected fixed governor is limited to politics 0..100
One or two supplied lots, exactly one initially empty; zero or one initial complete Lv1 forge; at most two current forges and one ever-created development job
Thirty explicit lot slots, each supplied lot present exactly once and every other slot null, including the currently empty lot
Fixed domestic difficulty/controller/pressure/unlock/specialty facts and complete separate hostile-force/field-unit facts
Initial finite ten-day date/turn and one-to-twelve advances; no implicit creation-time monthly settlement

provisionalPolicies.mapping: Independent profile, tags, save format, 84 public DTO aliases, seven APIs and one policy constant. Old root keeps its 71 aliases, seven APIs and 512 trace domain.

One AdvanceSharedFacilityTurn advances the sole clock once, applies AP recovery and complete construction effects, then performs monthly specialty if the new day is 1. Completion that day may participate immediately; this order is a simulation policy.

Derive each slot from the post-completion current.ledger.facilities and fixed lot mapping. Empty is validity0; developing is validity1/completed0; complete is validity1/completed1. Do not count levels or stale genesis facility snapshots.

Resolve the same supplied governor ID from current officers. Null governor yields complete no-governor items. Availability, acted and construction reservation do not block this monthly role; politics remains equal to genesis.
Creation never credits a month or assumes earlier payroll. Each accepted month-start receipt identifies exactly its city/year/month; history fold rejects duplicate settlement.
Retain full source arithmetic policy. In the bounded two-facility domain, factorValue may be 1.5 and scaledValue may be an exact half integer. No other DTO field gains fractional domain.

Call delivered single-equipment phases once in order 1,2,3 using frozen owned facts and a separate owned quantity/capacity stock. Verify complete response and exact stock after before copying only quantity to the same current.ledger.inventory[k] used by ordinary Produce. accepted=min(requested,capacity-before), discarded=requested-accepted; full stock still emits a complete write.

Core completion and all three monthly items share a single owned candidate. Any late failure discards every change. Monthly phase never changes AP/gold/TP, personnel progress/acted/reservation, facility usedTurn, equipment4, jobs, clock or history.
